about: What shape the dossier has, by what the reader came to do. A dossier has exactly one. Each kind has its own required sections (see CONTRIBUTING.md).

values.label: Comparison
values.means: Helps the reader choose. At least three options weighed against evidence, with a recommendation.

values.label: How-to
values.means: Helps the reader do one thing. Steps that were tried, and a way to check that it worked.

values.label: Trap
values.means: Warns the reader. One thing that goes wrong, how to spot it, why it happens and the fix.

values.label: Benchmark
values.means: Gives the reader numbers. Something measured with a method others can rerun, kept as run folders.

values.label: Dataset
values.means: Gives the reader data. A described set of files with links, checksums, licences and how it was made.
